name: clear-factual-error
description: Clear prose passes reader questions but contains a source-backed reference error. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: $kk:clarify-docs guide.md for restaurant owners using requirements.md and prep.py. Edit only guide.md.
trap: Skips a needed factual repair because all five comprehension answers already pass.

assertions.text: All five reader answers remain accurate; baseline reader answers alone do not justify a no-op.
Correct the reference maximum from 60 to 90 based on agreement between requirements.md and prep.py.
Preserve all other protected meaning and avoid gratuitous rewrites of already-clear orientation.
The trace shows source inspection; only guide.md changes.
